explanation: Choose every left-subtree size, recursively enumerate left and right shapes, and combine all pairs. The provided wrapper serializes each shape with explicit null children.
timeComplexity: O(n·Cₙ) conservative bound including shape serialization
spaceComplexity: O(n·Cₙ) generated shapes/output, plus O(n) recursion
